title: Port Indices Fit Within the Port Count
statement: For every natural number $k$ and every port $p$ among the state, input-head, input-symbol, work-head, work-symbol, summary, old-bit, and new-bit ports for $k$ work tapes, the index assigned to $p$ is strictly less than $3k+7$.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a port for $k$ work tapes
